Residue from NaHCO₃:
\[
\frac{M(\mathrm{Na_2CO_3})}{2M(\mathrm{NaHCO_3})}x
= \frac{105.988}{168.012}x
=0.630836x
\]

Residue from MgCO₃:
\[
\frac{M(\mathrm{MgO})}{M(\mathrm{MgCO_3})}(15.00-x)
= \frac{40.304}{84.313}(15.00-x)
=0.478028(15.00-x)
\]

Total residue:
\[
0.630836x + 0.478028(15.00-x)=8.80
\]
\[
0.152808x = 1.62958
\]
\[
x = 10.664 \text{ g}
\]

Mass percentage:
\[
\frac{10.664}{15.00}\times 100 = 71.1\%
